name: BioLink Protector Bot
description: A Telegram bot that automatically monitors user bios in group chats for links and can warn, mute, or ban users based on configurable settings.

scripts.postdeploy: echo 'Bot deployed successfully! Configure your bot token and MongoDB URI in the environment variables.'

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from my.telegram.org

MONGO_URI.description: Your MongoDB connection string (e.g., from MongoDB Atlas)

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram numeric user ID to enable /broadcast command
